content: What is the volume of the stapes in ZETA?
Measurements of ZETA, 1 structure(s), run 19ac527c · pipeline v0.1.0 · QC pass_with_warnings

The stapes volume in ZETA is **3.363 mm³**. This comes from run 19ac527c, pipeline v0.1.0. That run's QC status is "pass_with_warnings".

The segmentation has 1722 voxels and 3 connected components. The largest component makes up about 99.7% of the volume. The stapes is very small, so the extra components may be minor fragments. I haven't looked at the QC flags, so I can't say which warnings apply to the stapes. I can pull them if you want.

This is a single cadaveric specimen, so the value isn't a population reference.
